info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-Replace Banking Enterprise Services Fixed Asset Register-v5-spec
info.description: The Fixed Asset Register Management API enables financial institutions to efficiently update and manage their fixed asset records. This API facilitates the modification of asset details, ensuring accuracy and compliance with financial regulations. Typical consumers include banking operations teams and asset management software, who utilize this service for maintaining up-to-date asset information. Organizations can streamline their asset management processes while optimizing resource allocation and reporting through this powerful tool.

put.summary: Update an existing fixed asset register.
put.description: This operation allows you to update the details of a fixed asset register. You can modify asset information such as value, location, and status to keep the register up to date.

requestBody.description: This request body contains the details required to update a fixed asset in the register. The data should conform to the specified schema to ensure correct processing.

200.description: Request completed successfully and data updated.
